title: Rimini Street and American Digital Expand Partnership to Give SAP Licensees Greater Control Over Cloud Modernization
summary: American Digital is now a solution partner for Rimini Cloud™ for SAP, providing SAP licensees with a lower-risk, more flexible path to cloud modernization.
body_markdown:
## Rimini Cloud™ for SAP offers a smart path to modern cloud infrastructure without the risk of ERP reimplementation, forced subscription conversion or disruption to existing SAP investments


**LAS VEGAS – November 18, 2026 –**[Rimini Street, Inc.](https://www.riministreet.com/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=American_Digital_Rimini_Cloud_for_SAP) (Nasdaq: RMNI), the Software Support and Agentic AI ERP Company™ and the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software, today announced an expanded strategic partnership with American Digital Corporation to give SAP licensees a lower-risk, more flexible path to cloud modernization.


Through the expanded relationship, American Digital will serve as a solution partner for[Rimini Cloud™ for SAP](https://www.riministreet.com/solutions/software-supported/rimini-cloud-for-sap/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=American_Digital_Rimini_Cloud_for_SAP) , helping SAP ECC and S/4HANA licensees move their existing SAP systems to modern cloud infrastructure without requiring ERP reimplementation or conversion of perpetual licenses to subscriptions, while maintaining greater control over their long-term roadmap.


The announcement builds on a[strategic alliance established in 2025](https://www.riministreet.com/press-releases/rimini-street-and-american-digital-form-new-strategic-partnership/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=American_Digital_Rimini_Cloud_for_SAP) that brings together Rimini Street’s enterprise software support, managed services and ERP innovation expertise with American Digital’s infrastructure, cloud migration and managed services capabilities.


“SAP licensees should not have to choose between standing still and accepting a costly, disruptive transformation that may not align with their business priorities,” said[Keith Costello](https://www.riministreet.com/company/leadership/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=American_Digital_Rimini_Cloud_for_SAP#keith-costello) , chief operating officer, Rimini Street. “Through our expanded partnership with American Digital, Rimini Cloud for SAP gives SAP licensees a practical path to modernize the infrastructure beneath their existing SAP systems, preserve valuable licenses and customizations and determine when, where and how they invest in cloud, ERP and AI.”


“Moving SAP to the cloud doesn’t mean having to replace the ERP,” said Bob Panos, president, American Digital. “Through our expanded partnership with Rimini Street, we can help clients modernize with less disruption, clearer accountability and greater control over their technology investments.”


### Modernize the Infrastructure, Not the ERP


Rimini Cloud for SAP brings together the capabilities needed to migrate, operate, support and optimize existing SAP ECC and S/4HANA environments in the cloud. Rimini Street delivers mission-critical SAP software support, managed services and Agentic AI innovation, while American Digital provides the cloud infrastructure, migration services and SAP Basis managed services that support implementation and ongoing operations.


Rimini Cloud for SAP empowers SAP licensees to:


- **Modernize infrastructure without reimplementing the ERP** , decoupling cloud decisions from a broader and potentially disruptive application transformation.
- **Protect existing SAP investments** , including perpetual licenses, customizations, integrations and established business processes.
- **Reduce operational complexity** , with coordinated infrastructure, migration, SAP Basis, software support and application management services.
- **Maintain greater control of the SAP roadmap** , with greater flexibility to determine when and where to invest in ERP transformation, cloud services and emerging technologies.
- **Redirect resources toward higher-value priorities** , including process improvement, automation and Agentic AI ERP initiatives.


### Free Resources for Business and AI Innovation


By reducing the costs and operational demands associated with SAP infrastructure and ongoing management, organizations can allocate more resources to initiatives that advance the business, from process improvement and automation to Agentic AI ERP.


Combined with[Rimini Support™](https://www.riministreet.com/solutions/support-services/software-support/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=American_Digital_Rimini_Cloud_for_SAP) ,[Rimini Manage™](https://www.riministreet.com/solutions/support-services/application-management/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=American_Digital_Rimini_Cloud_for_SAP) and[Rimini Agentic UX™](https://www.riministreet.com/solutions/agentic-ai-erp/rimini-agentic-ux/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=American_Digital_Rimini_Cloud_for_SAP) solutions, Rimini Cloud for SAP is part of a broader[Rimini Smart Path™](https://www.riministreet.com/solutions/rimini-smart-path/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=American_Digital_Rimini_Cloud_for_SAP) strategy to help organizations protect, optimize and innovate with their existing ERP investments and deliver better business outcomes and competitive advantage now, not years from now.


[Learn more](https://www.riministreet.com/solutions/software-supported/rimini-cloud-for-sap/?utm_source=pressrelease&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=American_Digital_Rimini_Cloud_for_SAP) about how Rimini Cloud for SAP can help organizations modernize infrastructure while maintaining control of their SAP strategy.
